business_summary: GEOLIVE Group Corporation, through its subsidiaries, sells building materials, plywood, housing equipment, and DIY products in Japan. It also engages in other businesses, including logistics, the transportation of general cargo, construction and building contracting, information system leasing, real estate, housing materials, and IT system/logistics business. The company was formerly known as JUTEC Holdings Corporation and changed its name to GEOLIVE Group Corporation in September 2023. GEOLIVE Group Corporation was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
business_summary_ko: GEOLIVE Group Corporation은 자회사를 통해 일본에서 건축자재, 합판, 주택 장비, DIY 제품을 판매합니다. 그 밖에도 물류, 일반화물 운송, 건설 및 건물 도급, 정보시스템 임대, 부동산, 주택자재, IT 시스템/물류 사업 등의 사업도 영위하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 JUTEC Holdings Corporation으로 알려졌으며 2023년 9월에 GEOLIVE Group Corporation으로 이름을 변경했습니다. GEOLIVE Group Corporation은 2009년에 설립되었으며 일본 미나토에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
